title: WeatherCore Manual
summary: Read forecasts, scanners, radios, and storm profiles before routes turn hostile.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: WeatherCore makes the sky part of planning. Storms and forecasts can change when a route is safe, when a base is exposed, and when to delay a run.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Craft or find a weather radio or scanner, read the current profile, and avoid starting long trips under worsening conditions.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Check forecast, choose equipment, time the route, react to warnings, and update base layouts if weather repeatedly punishes the same area.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Weather profiles, radios, storm scanners, exposure notes, and hazard forecasts describe whether the problem is immediate, building, or regional.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: WorldCore regions can combine with weather pressure, HoloMap helps choose alternates, TutorialCore can coach hazard mistakes, and Recovery can help after a bad forecast call.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If weather feels random, start logging forecasts before routes. If a base is constantly exposed, change the base or route instead of fighting every storm manually.
